text:
{
  "protocol_id": "CTJ301UC201",
  "version": "Ver.1.1",
  "previous_version": "Ver.1.0",
  "spoken_summary": "This protocol update revises how patients are screened, randomized, and monitored for safety and efficacy throughout the trial. Site teams and data managers must update their clinical procedures and the electronic data capture build to match the new schedule and assessments.",
  "changes": [
    {
      "id": "CH-1",
      "section": "Cover Page",
      "page": 1,
      "quote": "Investigators: Multicenter, international, across Mainland China, Taiwan, Republic of Korea and Australia",
      "type": "admin",
      "summary": "Replaced Germany with Australia in the list of participating countries/regions.",
      "affects_edc": false,
      "edc_note": ""
    },
    {
      "id": "CH-2",
      "section": "Version of Protocol or Protocol Amendment",
      "page": 5,
      "quote": "VERSION OF PROTOCOL OR PROTOCOL AMENDMENT Document Date of issue V1.0 22 Feb 2017 V1.1 16 May 2017",
      "type": "admin",
      "summary": "Added a protocol version history table.",
      "affects_edc": false,
      "edc_note": ""
    },
    {
      "id": "CH-3",
      "section": "2.2 Endpoints",
      "page": 24,
      "quote": "Change from Baseline to Week 12 in modified Mayo score (=full Mayo score excluding Physician’s Global Assessment (PGA) subscore).",
      "type": "endpoint",
      "summary": "Added secondary endpoints for modified Mayo score at Week 12, PGA score at Weeks 4, 6, 8, 10, and 12, and FDA-defined remission at Week 12.",
      "affects_edc": true,
      "edc_note": "Add individual Mayo subscore fields (stool frequency, rectal bleeding, PGA, and endoscopy) to the MAYO and PMAYO forms so modified Mayo, PGA, and FDA-defined remission can be derived."
    },
    {
      "id": "CH-4",
      "section": "3.1.2 Overall Design",
      "page": 26,
      "quote": "Randomisation will be stratified by prior corticosteroids treatment (yes/no) and consent to participate in PK substudy (yes/no).",
      "type": "procedure",
      "summary": "Updated randomisation stratification factors to prior corticosteroids treatment and consent to participate in the PK substudy.",
      "affects_edc": true,
      "edc_note": "Ensure the RAND form collects prior corticosteroids treatment (STRATCS) and PK substudy consent (PKSUB) as stratification factors."
    },
    {
      "id": "CH-5",
      "section": "3.1.2 Overall Design",
      "page": 27,
      "quote": "At 1st dose: pre-dose and 0.5, 1, 2 (end of infusion), 6, 48, 144 (Day 6), and 240 (Day 10) h after the start of the 1st administration;",
      "type": "schedule",
      "summary": "Changed the post-infusion PK sampling timepoint from 1.5 hours to 2 hours (end of infusion).",
      "affects_edc": true,
      "edc_note": "Verify the PKTPT codelist uses 2 h (EOI) rather than 1.5 h for PK blood sampling."
    },
    {
      "id": "CH-6",
      "section": "3.3 Safety Review Committee",
      "page": 29,
      "quote": "The SRC is an expert advisory group commissioned and charged with the responsibility of evaluating, primarily, cumulative safety data at regular intervals.",
      "type": "admin",
      "summary": "Renamed the safety committee from DSMC to Safety Review Committee (SRC).",
      "affects_edc": false,
      "edc_note": ""
    },
    {
      "id": "CH-7",
      "section": "4.1.1 Inclusion Criteria",
      "page": 34,
      "quote": "4. During Day -35 to Day-6 prior to Randomisation, an endoscopy subscore ≥2.",
      "type": "eligibility",
      "summary": "Shortened the screening endoscopy window from Day -60 to Day -6 to Day -35 to Day -6 prior to randomisation.",
      "affects_edc": true,
      "edc_note": "Add or update an edit check on ENDO.ENDODTC to verify the screening endoscopy occurs within 35 to 6 days prior to V2 randomisation."
    },
    {
      "id": "CH-8",
      "section": "4.1.1 Inclusion Criteria",
      "page": 34,
      "quote": "and/or with medications containing 5-aminosalicylates (5-ASA) at no less than 2 g 5-ASA per day for at least 3 months and stable for at least 4 weeks prior to Randomization,",
      "type": "eligibility",
      "summary": "Lowered the minimum required 5-ASA dose for inclusion from 3 g per day to 2 g per day.",
      "affects_edc": false,
      "edc_note": ""
    },
    {
      "id": "CH-9",
      "section": "4.1.1 Inclusion Criteria",
      "page": 34,
      "quote": "8. The subject should be able to read and write to understand and fill out Patient Diary.",
      "type": "eligibility",
      "summary": "Added Inclusion Criterion 8 requiring subjects to be able to read and write to complete the Patient Diary.",
      "affects_edc": false,
      "edc_note": ""
    },
    {
      "id": "CH-10",
      "section": "4.1.2 Exclusion Criteria",
      "page": 34,
      "quote": "5. Current diagnosis of inflammatory bowel disease unclassified, Crohn's disease, ischemic colitis, fulminant colitis and/or toxic megacolon, patients with ulcerative colitis limited to the rectum (ulcerative proctitis), infective enteritis, amebic bowel disease and intestinal schistosomiasis.",
      "type": "eligibility",
      "summary": "Replaced the term indeterminate colitis with inflammatory bowel disease unclassified in Exclusion Criterion 5.",
      "affects_edc": false,
      "edc_note": ""
    },
    {
      "id": "CH-11",
      "section": "4.1.2 Exclusion Criteria",
      "page": 35,
      "quote": "17. Presence or history of active tuberculosis (TB) or latent TB infection, defined as 1) a positive QuantiFERON-TB Gold test at Screening, or 2) a positive T-spot test within 4 weeks of Randomisation and evidence of current or previous pulmonary tuberculosis by chest X-ray within 12 weeks of Randomisation.",
      "type": "eligibility",
      "summary": "Expanded Exclusion Criterion 17 to exclude patients with latent TB infection defined by QuantiFERON-TB Gold or T-spot plus chest X-ray.",
      "affects_edc": true,
      "edc_note": "Update the TB form to capture specific TB test type (QuantiFERON-TB Gold or T-spot), test date, and chest X-ray result and date."
    },
    {
      "id": "CH-12",
      "section": "5.1 Treatments Administered",
      "page": 39,
      "quote": "Manufacturer: Octoplus Development B.V. (now as Dr. Reddy’s Research &Development B.V.) , Netherlands",
      "type": "admin",
      "summary": "Corrected the IMP manufacturer name from OctoPlus N.V. to Octoplus Development B.V.",
      "affects_edc": false,
      "edc_note": ""
    },
    {
      "id": "CH-13",
      "section": "5.1 Treatments Administered",
      "page": 39,
      "quote": "The infusion time is 2 hours.",
      "type": "procedure",
      "summary": "Removed the ±3 minute tolerance from the 2-hour IMP infusion time.",
      "affects_edc": true,
      "edc_note": "Ensure any infusion duration edit check on the EX form does not enforce a ±3 minute tolerance around 2 hours."
    },
    {
      "id": "CH-14",
      "section": "6.1 Trial Flowchart",
      "page": 44,
      "quote": "Visits Visit 0 Stabilization Visit 1 Screening Visit 1.1 Baseline Visit 2 Baseline V 2.1 V 2.2 V2.3 V 3 V 4 V 5 V 6 V 7 V 7.1 V 7.2 V7.3 V 8 (EoT Visit) V 8.1 V 9 (Safety Follow-up Visit)",
      "type": "schedule",
      "summary": "Protocol includes PK subgroup visits V2.1, V2.2, V2.3, V7.1, V7.2, V7.3, and V8.1 with 48 h, 144 h, 240 h, and 480 h PK timepoints that are missing from the current EDC build.",
      "affects_edc": true,
      "edc_note": "Add dynamic PK subgroup events V2.1, V2.2, V2.3, V7.1, V7.2, V7.3, and V8.1 with their visit windows, attach the PK form, and add 48 h, 144 h, 240 h, and 480 h to the PKTPT codelist."
    },
    {
      "id": "CH-15",
      "section": "6.1 Trial Flowchart",
      "page": 44,
      "quote": "TB test • •",
      "type": "schedule",
      "summary": "Added a TB test at the Safety Follow-up Visit (Visit 9).",
      "affects_edc": true,
      "edc_note": "Confirm the TB form is scheduled at Visit 9 in addition to Visit 1."
    },
    {
      "id": "CH-16",
      "section": "6.1 Trial Flowchart",
      "page": 45,
      "quote": "Blood sampling for anti-TJ301 antibodies • • • • • •",
      "type": "schedule",
      "summary": "Added blood sampling for anti-TJ301 antibodies at Visit 3, and this form is currently absent from the EDC build.",
      "affects_edc": true,
      "edc_note": "Create an Anti-TJ301 Antibodies blood sampling form and schedule it at V2, V3, V4, V6, V8, and V9."
    },
    {
      "id": "CH-17",
      "section": "6.1 Trial Flowchart",
      "page": 45,
      "quote": "Physical examinationi • • • • • •",
      "type": "schedule",
      "summary": "Removed physical examination from Visits 3, 5, and 7, and this form is currently absent from the EDC build.",
      "affects_edc": true,
      "edc_note": "Create a Physical Examination form scheduled at V1, V1.1, V4, V6, V8, and V9 only (excluding V3, V5, and V7)."
    },
    {
      "id": "CH-18",
      "section": "6.1 Trial Flowchart",
      "page": 45,
      "quote": "Clinical laboratory testsg • • • • • • • • Pregnancy testh • • • Stool sample for Clostridium difficile assay •",
      "type": "schedule",
      "summary": "Protocol schedules clinical laboratory tests, pregnancy tests, C. difficile stool assay, vital signs, 12-lead ECG, biomarkers, concomitant medications, alcohol/tobacco habits, urine drug screening, and patient diary dispensing/review that are not present in the current EDC build.",
      "affects_edc": true,
      "edc_note": "Add missing forms for Clinical Labs, Pregnancy Test, C. difficile Assay, Vital Signs, 12-lead ECG, Biomarkers, Concomitant Medications, Alcohol/Tobacco Habits, Urine Drug Screen, and Diary Dispensing/Review at their Table 1 visits."
    },
    {
      "id": "CH-19",
      "section": "6.2.3 Baseline Visit (Visit 2)",
      "page": 50,
      "quote": "• Diary dispensing • Diary review",
      "type": "schedule",
      "summary": "Added diary dispensing and diary review to the Baseline Visit (Visit 2) procedures.",
      "affects_edc": true,
      "edc_note": "Include Diary Dispensing and Diary Review collection at V2."
    },
    {
      "id": "CH-20",
      "section": "7.1.1 Clinical and Endoscopic Disease Activity (Mayo Score)",
      "page": 53,
      "quote": "Note that the criteria of endoscopic appearance assessment in this study are DIFFERENT from the original criteria in (13). The Endoscopy subscore is modified so that a value of 1 does not include friability. Personnel responsible for endoscopic evaluation should NOT refer to the original criteria.",
      "type": "procedure",
      "summary": "Added clarification that the modified Mayo endoscopy subscore is used where a score of 1 does not include friability.",
      "affects_edc": true,
      "edc_note": "Update the ENDO form scoring labels and instructions to specify the modified Mayo endoscopy subscore without friability for score 1."
    },
    {
      "id": "CH-21",
      "section": "8.3 Adverse Events of Special Interest",
      "page": 61,
      "quote": "Adverse events of special interest include adverse events observed in earlier clinical development of TJ301 and those resulting from blocking IL-6 signaling shown by other drugs or investigational products.",
      "type": "safety",
      "summary": "Added a section defining Adverse Events of Special Interest (AESI) for TJ301 and IL-6 inhibitors.",
      "affects_edc": true,
      "edc_note": "Add an Adverse Event of Special Interest (AESI) indicator field to the AE form."
    },
    {
      "id": "CH-22",
      "section": "8.5.2 Collection, Recording and Reporting of Serious Adverse Events",
      "page": 64,
      "quote": "CRO contact information: Zhijia Han E-mail: zhijia.han@tigermed.net",
      "type": "admin",
      "summary": "Updated the CRO safety reporting contact from Haiyan Liu to Zhijia Han.",
      "affects_edc": false,
      "edc_note": ""
    },
    {
      "id": "CH-23",
      "section": "Appendix 2 – Laboratory Parameters",
      "page": 87,
      "quote": "• HIV (HIV-1/2 Antigen and Antibodies) • HBV (Hepatitis B Surface Antigen) • HCV (Hepatitis C Antibody) • TB (QuantiFERON-TB Gold; or T-spot test plus chest X-ray) • EBV [Viral capsid antigen (VCA)-IgM test and VCA-IgG test] • CMV (if applicable; CMV DNA load by real-time polymerase chain reaction assay)",
      "type": "procedure",
      "summary": "Specified detailed assays for HIV, HBV, HCV, TB, EBV, and CMV screening.",
      "affects_edc": true,
      "edc_note": "Update the VIRO and TB forms to capture individual results for each specified infectious disease assay."
    },
    {
      "id": "CH-24",
      "section": "Appendix 3 – Patient Diary (blank sample)",
      "page": 89,
      "quote": "Instructions for recording the number of stools and their worst rectal bleeding over a 24-hour period:",
      "type": "procedure",
      "summary": "Added instructions defining stool and rectal bleeding categories for completing the Patient Diary.",
      "affects_edc": false,
      "edc_note": ""
    }
  ]
}
